plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Neighborhood Safety Network to use your location to report local incidents and show nearby alerts.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Neighborhood Safety Network to access your photos to attach evidence to incident reports.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Neighborhood Safety Network to access your camera to take real-time photos of safety incidents.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Neighborhood Safety Network to access your contacts to easily select your emergency contact.
